headline: Dylan Larkin's expanded trade list leaks, includes 10 U.S. teams: Source
take:
Per The Athletic, Dylan Larkin's expanded trade list has leaked and includes 10 U.S. teams, and the outlet's early trade board says trades involving him and Connor Hellebuyck look inevitable this season. The Athletic also notes Larkin has scored 30-plus goals in five straight seasons with the Red Wings.

Our numbers say he is not much of a drag on Detroit. So far this season, Larkin has one goal and five points in seven games, but his own expected goals (a measure of the quality of his chances) sit at 1.79, nearly a full goal more than he has scored. That gap looks like bad finishing luck, not a decline, and his 34 goals in 74 games last year fit that read. At 5-on-5, DET takes 51.34 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, a modest edge, while the team's share with him is basically unchanged from without him (-0.1 percentage points).

DET sits at 3-3-3 with 49.7 percent of expected goals overall, and its goals are 7.1 below what its chances predict, so the whole club is underscoring. For fantasy managers, Larkin is a buy-low candidate. For a buyer, he is a 30-goal scorer who is driving play at a steady level.
